name: card-history
purpose: Resolve the card before and after a balance patch and the changed stats, to render and insert Hearthstone card changes into articles.

endpoints.images: https://api.kolodahearthstone.com/uploads/card-history-media/{sha256}.png; loaded by readers' browsers, never fetched by the server

authentication: None for the provider; GET without credentials, cookies or user identifiers. Editor endpoint wp_ajax_hs_card_changes requires nonce hs_card_changes and edit_post on the edited post.
data_classes: patch date entered by the editor
public card names, stats and archive image hashes

retry.backoff: No in-request retry; provider-wide cooldown of 60 seconds on error, honoring numeric or HTTP-date Retry-After between 60 and 3600 seconds.

idempotency: Read-only GET. Shortcode rendering and dialog composition perform no provider writes; the editor insert is undoable and never saves the post.
rate_limit: At most 4 parallel requests, 9 seconds of provider time per page render, 50 versions per page and 3 pages per card, 512 KiB response cap. A resolved pair is cached 30 days, so a card is requested once per patch date; search and composition run only while an editor uses the dialog, and one editor may resolve at most 60 cards per minute.
degradation: A cached pair, or a pair pinned in the shortcode by the editor dialog, renders without any request. During an outage uncached cards render as plates without images; the last good copy is served for 30 days. The page render never throws.
privacy: Only card identifiers and a date leave the server, with a service User-Agent and no article text. Card images are loaded by the reader's browser from api.kolodahearthstone.com, which therefore sees the reader's network address like any third-party image host. No new cookies, tracking, storage or personal data.
rollback: Revert the plugin release through the normal pipeline. Shortcodes remain plain text in post_content; no DB schema, media mutation or destructive uninstall. Cached transients expire on their own.
